body_html:
Statement from the Educational Justice Collective:

After much thoughtful deliberation, we have decided to change our name from "Urban Education Fellows," to "Educational Justice Collective." This change was sparked through our recognition of what it is that some audiences hear when we use the word "urban." In our growth as educators and advocates, we have gained the knowledge that the word "urban" does have an underlying connotation. As a group, our efforts often serve to change the conversation, not shy away from it, and thus, why we feel that this change in our name is necessary.

We have also taken the opportunity to redefine our mission, and as a result of this, have chosen a name that more accurately reflects what we have outlined. "Educational Justice Collective" embodies everything that we stand for. Our purpose is made clear just by looking at our name.

We look forward to the work that lies ahead of us and remain steadfast in our commitment to racial and intersectional justice in education.

~ The Educational Justice Collective
Southern Connecticut State University
